svg.title: Codex Clock — sample dashboard
svg.desc: An illustrative Codex Clock dashboard with 62% weekly allowance remaining, 148.6 million tokens today, 684 thousand work units, seven active productivity bars, and fifteen sample threads. The second thread is expanded to show its session chart, token mix, two-model breakdown, and session details. Typography uses vector outlines of the app's Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts.
